# How To Use Newlines

Source: [4832](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4832); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4832-n1"></a>

- Newlines can be inserted as escaped \n in copied Workshop text and pasted back; replace or disable the old action to avoid duplicates.

<a id="wiki-4832-n2"></a>

- Leading newline is documented as rendering a square; prefix a space or invisible character as workaround.
